name: @datacenter-tycoon/desktop
description: Electron desktop app for Datacenter Tycoon.
author: Datacenter Tycoon

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -s first -n renderer,tsc,electron "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run dev:watch" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 dist/main/index.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=development ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electronmon dist/main/index.js
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron && npm run sync:renderer
scripts.test:ci: mkdir -p coverage && c8 --report-dir=coverage --reporter=lcov --reporter=text-summary --all --include=src/**/*.ts --exclude='src/**/*.test.ts' node --test --import tsx --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=coverage/junit.xml $(find src -type f -name '*.test.ts' | sort)
